Address on record: 7/72B, VADAKKANPAGAM PULLUVILAI STREET (Tuticorin, Tamil Nadu area). Role appears to be manufacturer-exporter of coconut/neem derivatives rather than pure trader, but that is inferred from product descriptions only, not from a registry check. Caveats: (1) only 5 of the claimed 47 rows were visible in the free view, so volume cannot be independently confirmed; (2) no second independent source could be opened (volza/eximpedia/trademo all 403), so the shipment data rests on a single aggregator; (3) domestic Indian supply activity is unverified — absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not evidence of absence; (4) revenue and export value: null, not public in the free view.
